text:
elaine: noticed console panel (usage / cost over time) freezes when quickly toggling time-range + applying 3+ filters. repro: open panel, click 3 filters fast, chart stops updating for ~6-8s then snaps. seen on staging+prod.
sam: can repro on mac chrome. CPU spikes in tab. looks like main thread busy, not network. :thinking_face:
jonah: any stack traces from RUM? do we have a trace id?
elaine: @jonah here's the one from last run: trace=trace_19412abc. RUM shows long task at "parseChartConfig" and then big GC. attaching snippet from devtools timeline.
maggie: hmm maybe the new filter-state serializer we shipped in last release is doing deep clone of full series array. that would explain parse + GC.
diego: i suspected that too. recent change replaced shallow refs with JSON.stringify -> JSON.parse to normalize filters (PR #4211).
sam: ugh. that was to fix a stale-props bug for rollouts, but cost too much for big charts. verify: timeline shows 5.3s spent in V8.compile and parse.
elaine: paste from devtools flame:
```
Main thread
  - render: 24ms
  - parseChartConfig: 5203ms
  - applyFilters: 18ms
  - setState (batch): 12ms
  - GC: 1300ms
```
jonah: so real culprit is parseChartConfig doing expensive reduce/map over 10k series entries. where are those series coming from? server returning full unaggregated series?
maggie: server returns pre-aggregated buckets, but client expands them into per-series objects when filters apply. the JSON.clone made a fresh deep copy each interaction.
diego: quick mitigation: debounce filter updates to 200-300ms and avoid deep clone. small PR: return shallow copy and only deep-copy series when we mutate.
sam: can we also limit number of series serialized to client? maybe cap at 500 and show "more". that reduces memory pressure.
elaine: agree. but need quick hotfix for prod -> rollback the JSON clone change and add debounce.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: revert-pr-4211-hotfix (staging -> canary -> prod). estimated deploy in 2m.
jonah: longer-term: move heavy expansion into web worker so main thread isn't blocked. also cache expanded results keyed by filters hash (KV cache in console runtime) so toggling back is instant.
maggie: +1 on worker and memoization. also add telemetry event for "filters_applied" with duration_ms and series_count so we can alert on regressions.
diego: I'll open a RFC for worker + cache pattern; include perf budget: keep parseChartConfig < 200ms p95.
sam: action items:
- diego: revert clone + debounce hotfix -> 1941234590 (in flight)
- jonah: add RUM metric for filters_applied (schema + backend) by EOD
- maggie: patch client to avoid deep clone and add shallow-copy doc comment
- elaine: monitor canary, post back in this thread in 10m
elaine: thanks y'all. will monitor logs and paste canary numbers here.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: revert-pr-4211-hotfix -> canary group (5%)
elaine: canary looks good so far, CPU down to baseline. charts responsive. will promote after 10m.
sam: once promoted let's also ship telemetry so we have an automatic guard next time.
elaine: noted. :thumbsup:
